citations.claim: energy still below limit before bounce
first violating step energy exceeds allowed 1000.31

counterfactual.change: lowered restitution e from 0.99784 to 0.8 to restore dissipation on bounce; predicts no energy injection

explanation: Shrunk case has no controller (work=0) so energy should only decrease. Body bounces elastically (e~0.998) against top wall around steps 60-63. Inspect shows substeps=5 during high-speed approach and energy jumps at the bounce from ~988 J to ~1003 J, exceeding E0+10%+5J. Reducing restitution removes the gain, indicating collision response/positional correction injects energy when correcting high restitution top-wall contact with substepped integration.
vision_note: From step 60 to 63 the blue body stays against the top boundary to the right of the vertical grey wall, moving downward only a small amount each frame with no visible wall crossing or deep penetration. No tunneling, ejection, or second body is apparent; the motion looks like a gentle top-wall contact/slide rather than a dramatic bounce.
